info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to breathe,to live, to inhale, to be able

examples: 'tA varuRagfhItAH paridIrRA anatyaSca prARatyaSca SiSyire' (Sa॰brA॰2.5.2.2). prARatyaH=niHSvasatyaH.
'antaScarati rocanA'sya prARAdapAnatI' (f॰10.189.2). apAnatI=nizkrAmantI. avyavahitapUrvaM prARAdityukteratrAnitiH kriyAsAmAnyamAha.
'adyA mamAra sa hyaH samAna' (f॰10.55.5). samAnetyaniteH samupasfzwasya liwi praTamEkavacane rUpam. jijIva, jIvitaM leBe SvasanamApetyarTaH.
'etAM diSamanavAnantsftvA kumBaM prakzIyAnapekzamARa ehi' (Sa0 brA0 13.8.3.4). anavAnan=aniSvasan.
'imAH prajAH prARatyaScodAnatyaScAntarikzamanucaranti' (Sa0 brA0 3.8.3.2). udAnatya ucCvAsaM kurvatyaH.
'fcA prARihi yajuzA samanihi sAmnodanihi' (SAM0 gf0 9.24.2). udanihi udAnAKyaH SvAsaste prertAmityAha.
'apahAya muKamaBiprARan' (satyA0 SrO0 24.1.13). aBiprARan ucCvasan. muKamapahAya=muKamanyato nItvA.
